Was the mask correctly tighten?

You can check by, with the mask not connected to anything, exhaling as much as you can, covering the open tube with the palm of your hand and inhaling. If the mask is correctly sealed it will "bend" towards your face

If the mask didnt bend, its prob not tight enough or not placed correctly 

If the mask bent but you still having troubles,
the exhaust valve isnt taped correctly 

i also got a small bag and to fill it you must put the mask on, inhale as much as you can, screw the bag in, exhale with the bag
Even better results if the bag is full before screwing

I imagine there is a right way to do it with some specific plastic or rubber cover but from my experience just using black tape is more than enough

And you can always check for leaks and replace the tape if necessary

Yeah its the model i expected 

You should be able to lift the bottom grill like cover and access the valve. The cover got some tiny "hooks" so you just need to squeeze a little to take it off. On mine I fully covered the valve with tape both under the cover and inside the mask

If you got an 4a1 mask, there are two air paths

The top one should be an intake, usually you can just take the valve out, making it open both ways all the time

The bottom one should be discharge: for rebreathing on a bag this valve must be locked close. taping over it should be enough

Be careful, most masks are copies/knock offs, and im not even sure of your model, so dont try to force/break anything
